cards.gloss_en: hard to move or handle because of size or weight
cards.ex_en: The old sofa was too unwieldy to carry upstairs.
cards.ex_cn: 那张旧沙发太笨重,搬不上楼。

cards.gloss_en: lift or raise, often with ropes or effort
cards.ex_en: The workers hoisted the heavy box onto the truck.
cards.ex_cn: 工人们把重箱子吊上卡车。

cards.gloss_en: small casks or barrels for holding liquid
cards.ex_en: He filled two small runlets with fresh water.
cards.ex_cn: 他往两个小桶里装满淡水。

cards.gloss_en: light and easy to carry around
cards.ex_en: I bought a small portable radio for the trip.
cards.ex_cn: 我买了台便携小收音机去旅行。

cards.gloss_en: easily and conveniently
cards.ex_en: She keeps her tools handily beside the door.
cards.ex_cn: 她把工具顺手放在门边。

cards.gloss_en: sharp blades for shaving hair
cards.ex_en: He packed two razors in his bag.
cards.ex_cn: 他往包里装了两把剃刀。

cards.gloss_en: covered with clouds; dull and grey
cards.ex_en: The sky was overcast, so we stayed home.
cards.ex_cn: 天阴沉沉的,我们就待在家。

cards.gloss_en: several; various (old use)
cards.ex_en: Divers goods were left on the shore.
cards.ex_cn: 岸上留下了几样货物。

cards.gloss_en: not suitable or fitting
cards.ex_en: It is improper to shout in a library.
cards.ex_cn: 在图书馆里大喊是不合适的。

cards.gloss_en: amuse oneself; pass time pleasantly
cards.ex_en: He read comics to divert himself.
cards.ex_cn: 他读漫画来消遣。

cards.gloss_en: made larger or bigger
cards.ex_en: They enlarged the small window last year.
cards.ex_cn: 他们去年把小窗户扩大了。

cards.gloss_en: of or happening in autumn
cards.ex_en: The autumnal wind felt cool and dry.
cards.ex_cn: 秋天的风又凉又干。

cards.gloss_en: left out; failed to include
cards.ex_en: She omitted my name from the list.
cards.ex_cn: 她把我的名字从名单上漏掉了。

cards.gloss_cn: 值得一记的、不寻常的;著名的、卓越的
cards.gloss_en: notable or remarkable; also famous
cards.ex_en: He is an eminent doctor in our town.
cards.ex_cn: 他是我们镇上著名的医生。

cards.gloss_en: used carefully and sparingly
cards.ex_en: They husbanded their food through the long winter.
cards.ex_cn: 他们省着吃食物熬过漫长的冬天。

cards.gloss_en: think up or plan something new
cards.ex_en: We must devise a plan to save water.
cards.ex_cn: 我们得想个办法节约用水。

cards.gloss_en: know or expect before it happens
cards.ex_en: No one could foresee the sudden storm.
cards.ex_cn: 没人能预见这场突如其来的暴风雨。

cards.gloss_en: studying or reading with close attention
cards.ex_en: She spent all night poring over her notes.
cards.ex_cn: 她整晚专注地钻研笔记。

cards.gloss_en: one who owes money; the debit side
cards.ex_en: The debtor promised to pay back the money.
cards.ex_cn: 那个债务人答应还钱。

cards.gloss_en: a tool for cutting and shaping wood
cards.ex_en: The carpenter shaped the wood with an adze.
cards.ex_cn: 木匠用锛子削出木料的形状。

cards.gloss_en: cut or chop with an axe
cards.ex_en: They hew logs to build a cabin.
cards.ex_cn: 他们砍木头盖小屋。

cards.gloss_en: the distance across; width
cards.ex_en: The river is ten metres in breadth.
cards.ex_cn: 这条河宽十米。

cards.gloss_en: threw up from the stomach
cards.ex_en: The sick child vomited after dinner.
cards.ex_cn: 那生病的孩子晚饭后吐了。

cards.gloss_en: hold back; keep oneself from doing something
cards.ex_en: I could not forbear laughing at his joke.
cards.ex_cn: 我忍不住笑他的笑话。

cards.gloss_en: past participle of get
cards.ex_en: The weather has gotten colder this week.
cards.ex_cn: 这周天气变冷了。

cards.gloss_en: the broken remains of something destroyed
cards.ex_en: We walked among the ruins of the old castle.
cards.ex_cn: 我们在古堡的废墟间散步。

cards.gloss_en: sudden strong bursts of wind
cards.ex_en: Sudden gusts blew the leaves everywhere.
cards.ex_cn: 突来的阵风把树叶吹得到处都是。

cards.gloss_en: half of a circle
cards.ex_en: The children sat in a semicircle around the teacher.
cards.ex_cn: 孩子们围着老师坐成半圆。

cards.gloss_en: an underground room or arched chamber
cards.ex_en: They stored the wine in a cool vault.
cards.ex_cn: 他们把酒存在阴凉的地窖里。

cards.gloss_en: made unable to walk properly
cards.ex_en: The fall lamed the poor horse.
cards.ex_cn: 那一摔使可怜的马跛了。

cards.gloss_en: raising and producing young animals
cards.ex_en: The breeding of goats kept him busy.
cards.ex_cn: 养山羊让他很忙。

cards.gloss_en: making something complete or faultless
cards.ex_en: She spent years perfecting her cooking.
cards.ex_cn: 她花了多年把厨艺练到完美。

cards.gloss_en: the cord in a candle that burns
cards.ex_en: He lit the wick of the candle.
cards.ex_cn: 他点燃了蜡烛的灯芯。

cards.gloss_en: the dry outer coverings of grain
cards.ex_en: The husks of the corn lay on the floor.
cards.ex_cn: 玉米的外壳撒在地上。

cards.gloss_en: until now; up to this time
cards.ex_en: The plan had hitherto worked well.
cards.ex_cn: 这计划迄今为止一直很顺利。

cards.gloss_en: things produced or brought forth
cards.ex_en: These fruits are the productions of his garden.
cards.ex_cn: 这些水果是他花园的出产。

cards.gloss_en: not expected or predicted
cards.ex_en: An unforeseen problem delayed the trip.
cards.ex_cn: 一个没料到的问题耽误了行程。

cards.gloss_en: breaking into small pieces; falling apart
cards.ex_en: The old wall was slowly crumbling.
cards.ex_cn: 那堵老墙在慢慢崩塌。

cards.gloss_en: ripped or pulled apart
cards.ex_en: His shirt was torn at the sleeve.
cards.ex_cn: 他的衬衫袖子破了。

cards.gloss_en: trade or dealing in goods (old use)
cards.ex_en: The two towns had much traffic in salt.
cards.ex_cn: 两个镇子间有很多盐的买卖。

cards.gloss_en: small cuts or nicks in a surface
cards.ex_en: He cut small notches in the stick.
cards.ex_cn: 他在棍子上刻了些小刻痕。

cards.gloss_en: a careful look over; an inspection
cards.ex_en: He took a quick survey of his supplies.
cards.ex_cn: 他把补给品快速清点了一遍。

cards.gloss_en: apart; into separate pieces
cards.ex_en: The rope was torn asunder by the storm.
cards.ex_cn: 绳子被暴风雨扯成两截。

cards.gloss_en: metal pins used to fasten things together
cards.ex_en: He tightened the iron bolts on the gate.
cards.ex_cn: 他拧紧了大门上的铁螺栓。

cards.gloss_en: cooked slowly in liquid
cards.ex_en: She stewed the meat for two hours.
cards.ex_cn: 她把肉炖了两个小时。

cards.gloss_en: a long pole with a sharp point, used as a weapon
cards.ex_en: The hunter threw his spear at the deer.
cards.ex_cn: 猎人向鹿掷出长矛。

cards.gloss_en: dullness of mind; lack of feeling or sense
cards.ex_en: His stupidity made everyone angry.
cards.ex_cn: 他的愚蠢让大家都生气。

suspect.ctx: we had in the ship a dog and two cats, of whose eminent history I may have occasion to say something in its place
suspect.issue: 现义指人出名/杰出;此处修饰狗和两只猫的"history","著名的历史"回读不通,Defoe此处义为"值得一记的、非同寻常的"
suspect.suggest: 补"(经历、事迹)值得一提的、不寻常的"这一义项
